description: Implementation of SensorList class managing sensor objects, including adding, removing, querying, and dumping sensor information, with integration to protobuf serialization.

classes.name: SensorList
classes.description: Manages a list of sensors, providing methods to add, remove, query, and dump sensor data.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a sensor to the list if handle is unique and matches sensor handle.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a sensor from the list by handle.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a sensor by handle.

methods.name: getStringType
methods.description: Retrieves the string type of a sensor by handle.

methods.name: getInterface
methods.description: Gets the sensor interface object by handle.

methods.name: isNewHandle
methods.description: Checks if a handle is new (not used).

methods.name: getUserSensors
methods.description: Returns sensors for user, excluding debug and dynamic sensors.

methods.name: getRuntimeSensors
methods.description: Returns sensors for a specific device ID.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs sensor list information as a formatted string.

methods.name: dump (protobuf version)
methods.description: Outputs sensor list information as protobuf messages.
